description:
The Sun's apparent elevation and azimuth (from true north) at a place and time, and the
        shadow a vertical object casts on level ground (NOAA solar position, refraction included).

object_height_m.description: Height of a vertical object, for its shadow
object_height_m.title: Object Height M

time.description: ISO 8601, with a UTC offset (2026-12-21T12:00:00+11:00) or local with tz
time.title: Time

tz.description: IANA time zone for a local time, e.g. Australia/Melbourne
tz.title: Tz

name: sun_position

elevation_deg.description: Apparent elevation above a flat horizon, refraction included
elevation_deg.title: Elevation Deg

provenance.description: Source, licence, attribution, retrieval time and method
provenance.title: Provenance

shadow_direction_deg.description: Direction the shadow points, from true north
shadow_direction_deg.title: Shadow Direction Deg

title: Sun position and shadow
